style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Berry & Pine Cone Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of woodland wonder to your space with this charming 35cm artificial berry and pine cone wreath—a compact yet captivating piece that brings the magic of the forest indoors. Bursting with rich red berries, textured pine cones, and lifelike greenery, this wreath delivers a warm, rustic vibe that feels like a cosy winter cabin. Its smaller size makes it incredibly versatile—perfect for apartment doors, kitchen walls, layered on shelves, or even used as a candle ring centrepiece. Wherever it goes, it brings timeless seasonal charm without the mess of falling needles or dried-out foliage. Whether you're decking the halls or adding a festive flourish to your everyday décor, this wreath proves that small can still be stunning. Wreath width: D35 cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
